investigator.method: One bounded, unauthenticated GET of the discovery-supplied official_website via curl (descriptive User-Agent, redirects followed, no retries, no browser, no auth).

identity.notes: Retrieved page title 'The Phoenix Theatre | Official Site' and footer address 'Phoenix Theatre, Charing Cross Road, London WC2H 0JP' match the candidate name and given address exactly. Page footer credits '© ATG Entertainment'.

probe_history.reason: The single unauthenticated GET returned a real, current programme listing directly on the page — sufficient to reach an honest identity and music-relevance decision without escalating.

title.notes: The homepage states directly: 'Stranger Things: The First Shadow — Fri 17 Nov 2023 - Sun 27 Dec 2026', and describes the venue's history as 'the very best of live theatre' with productions from Noël Coward and Stephen Sondheim.

start_date.notes: The retrieved page shows an overall production run/season rather than individually dated performance instances in this bounded static probe.

venue_location.notes: The retrieved page states this address directly and it matches the candidate's given address.

reasons: The venue's own current programme, as retained directly from https://www.thephoenixtheatre.co.uk/, is theatrical staged production(s) — 'Stranger Things: The First Shadow' — not live music, concerts, or DJ/club-night performance.

evidence.description: Literal, contiguous excerpt of the real HTTP response body from the official site showing the current production listing and venue address.
evidence.method: curl; descriptive User-Agent; unauthenticated GET; redirects followed; bounded response; single request, no retry
